crossRefs.note: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim…

translations.web: “ ‘Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.
translations.bsb: When she saw that she had waited in vain, that her hope was lost, she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
translations.kjv: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
translations.asv: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
